meta.name: tech-debt-audit
meta.description: Thorough, file-cited technical debt audit across 9 dimensions using AST-grep (tree-sitter), grep, LSP, and language-native tooling. Produces TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md with severity, effort estimates, and prioritized fixes. Use when asked for codebase health check, tech debt audit, architecture review, code quality assessment, or cleanup planning. Triggers: 'tech debt', 'technical debt', 'debt audit', 'code health', 'technical debt audit', 'codebase health check', 'find tech debt', 'debt analysis', 'audit code quality'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审计代码库九大维度,输出带优先级的技术债报告。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想动手重构前先摸清代码库里哪些地方最该修。
copy.tagline_en: Audit code on 9 dimensions and get a prioritized tech-debt report.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to know what to fix before refactoring.

howto.what: 它扫描代码库,按架构、类型、测试、安全等 9 类维度查找技术债;每条问题附上对应文件、行号、严重度与预估修复工时,最终写成 TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md,并按影响/工时排出优先修复顺序和 30 分钟内可做的快速赢清单。
howto.when: 当你要求做技术债审计、代码健康检查或架构评审等代码质量任务,或说“tech debt”“code health”等触发词时触发。

say.text: 帮我审计这个项目的技术债,按严重度排序输出。
检查代码库健康状况,列出 5 个最值得优先修的问题。
say.note: 给出文件行号和预估工时。

say.text: 只做快速修复清单,别管大改动。
say.note: 筛出 30 分钟内能改完的项。

howto.what_en: Scans the codebase for tech debt across 9 dimensions; each finding cites file:line, severity, estimated effort. Writes TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md with executive summary, top priorities, and quick wins.
howto.when_en: Activates when you ask for a tech-debt audit, codebase health check, architecture review, or similar code-quality task, or say triggers like 'tech debt' or 'code health'.

say_en.text: Audit this project for tech debt and rank the findings by severity.
Check codebase health and list the top 5 issues to fix first.
say_en.note: Each issue includes file:line and effort estimate.

say_en.text: Only show quick wins, skip the larger changes.
say_en.note: It will filter to items fixable in under 30 minutes.
